findings.summary: The brief explicitly requires that an unreachable target 'reflect the actual achievable weight (rounded down)', but none of the 3 tests exercise that path — all 3 either hit the target exactly or land on the target==bar edge case. I hand-traced the algorithm against the round-down scenarios from the plan (22kg target/20kg bar → empty plates, achieved 20kg; 84kg target → [25,5,1.25], achieved 82.5kg; 81.25kg target with a plate set lacking 1.25kg → [25,5], achieved 80kg) and the implementation is correct for all three, so this is a coverage gap rather than a live bug — but the round-down branch (the `while` loop simply exhausting without reaching remaining≈0) is currently unguarded by any regression test, so a future refactor of the loop/epsilon logic could silently break it.
